bugs.title: AAR Metadata check compileSdk mismatch
bugs.root_cause: compileSdk was configured lower than required by AndroidX transitive libraries
bugs.fix_summary: Configured compileSdk to 36 and used stable library versions in libs.versions.toml

bugs.title: Missing Compose imports in InvoiceEditorScreen
bugs.root_cause: Missing Compose imports for AlertDialog, TextButton, size, and delegated property smart cast
bugs.fix_summary: Added missing imports and resolved delegated property casting

bugs.title: Tax code line overlaps with wrapped company address
bugs.root_cause: Y-coordinate calculation in drawWrappedText didn't account for multi-line address height when drawing subsequent tax code label
bugs.fix_summary: Implemented drawInfoRow to dynamically calculate height per field and advance Y-coordinate accurately

bugs.title: Service content text is drawn top-aligned instead of vertically centered in Quotation table row
bugs.root_cause: drawCenteredWrappedText used a fixed top Y offset (rowTop + 40f) instead of calculating baseline startY centered vertically around the cell's center line
bugs.fix_summary: Implemented getWrappedLines and drawVerticallyCenteredWrappedText to dynamically balance multi-line text vertically around rowTop + rowHeight / 2

bugs.title: Double window insets avoidance caused extra top status bar gap and redundant bottom bar spacing
bugs.root_cause: Root Scaffold in MainActivity consumed top and bottom insets, which were then consumed a second time by child screen Scaffolds and TopAppBars
bugs.fix_summary: Set contentWindowInsets = WindowInsets(0, 0, 0, 0) on root Scaffold and only padded bottom bar height where appropriate

bugs.title: Store partner ID was overwritten with new UUID on invoice save causing store not found on detail screen return
bugs.root_cause: saveStore replaced entire StorePartner object with new random UUID when matched by name, changing its primary ID
bugs.fix_summary: Preserved existing.id and existing metadata during store updates and preserved existing StorePartner entity in invoice saving

bugs.title: Scroll position lost when navigating to preview/edit and back
bugs.root_cause: Screens were unmounted on navigation without SaveableStateHolder and LazyColumns lacked preserved list state
bugs.fix_summary: Integrated SaveableStateHolder in MainActivity and bound rememberLazyListState to all screen LazyColumns

bugs.title: Selecting store in editor inherited old debt even when marked as paid
bugs.root_cause: applyStorePartner took .totalAmount instead of .remainingDebt (which respects isPaid flag)
bugs.fix_summary: Changed applyStorePartner to take latestInvoice?.remainingDebt ?: 0.0 and sync both oldDebt and initialOldDebt

bugs.title: Crash with IllegalArgumentException in SaveableStateHolder when passing AppScreen object as key
bugs.root_cause: AppScreen sealed class does not implement Parcelable and cannot be stored directly in an Android Bundle
bugs.fix_summary: Added String property screenKey to AppScreen and passed String keys into SaveableStateProvider

bugs.title: Lưu hóa đơn báo thành công khi ghi file thất bại hoặc ghi chồng nhau
Nội dung dài ở đầu/cuối báo giá A4 có thể bị cắt trong PDF/ảnh
